statements.text: Eric Golz was named head coach of the Dayton women's soccer program by Vice President/Director of Athletics Neil Sullivan on Dec. 20, 2016.
In 2017, Golz's first season, Dayton went 6-3-0 at Baujan Field, including starting the season with five consecutive home wins, and outscoring opponents 13-0 in those matches.
